recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-15853 unless a future build process changes the Reference page source unexpectedly.
issue_request: FHIR-15853 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core change request for references.html section 2.3.0.2. It asked to fix a typo where the relative Patient reference example prose said the element was named context while the example XML used a different element.
initial_application: The issue was applied in svn revision 14236, mirrored as git commit cd076a55667877ee07e048a7d1025b013aae4239 with subject "GF#15853 - fix typo". That commit changed the stale context/patient wording to subject, and svn revision 14248, mirrored as c186eb68d4e1ad666db113ba8611651919b0ce38, fixed the malformed code tag left by the first edit.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Reference as an active type and normative datatype, confirming that the Reference narrative is in current build scope. Current source/references.html says the element is named subject and shows matching subject XML tags. Targeted Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant conflicting discussion or later decision.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The audit commit records that the current source already satisfies FHIR-15853 and that the stale context wording is absent.
